name: trackkr
description: Reports the active tab to a trackkrd daemon running on this machine.

gecko.//strict_min_version: Set by what the manifest keys need, not by guesswork: optional_host_permissions landed in 128 and data_collection_permissions in 142. A lower floor lets the extension install where the runtime permission request cannot work.
gecko.//data_collection_permissions: Recording which pages were open and for how long is the entire point, so browsingActivity is required rather than optional; page titles are read off the page, hence websiteContent.
